props.description: Key that moves focus to the toasts, such as "F8" or "Alt+T". null turns it off.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Name of the region landmark. The default is English, so pass a name in your app's language.

components.name: Toast.Root
components.description: One toast, in one of four tones. Takes native div attributes.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colors from color.status.<tone> through the toast contract tokens.

props.name: children
props.description: Toast parts, or any content.

components.name: Toast.Title
components.description: Short summary, set in the title weight. A p element.

props.name: children
props.description: Title text.

components.name: Tooltip.Root
components.description: Tip chrome. Spread getTooltipProps for wire.

props.name: children
props.description: Tooltip text, or short prose plus links when interactive.

props.name: className
props.description: Class name for the tip surface.

props.name: style
props.description: Style for the tip surface. Anchor position comes from getTooltipProps.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when no visible caption exists. Exactly one of aria-label or aria-labelledby when interactive.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the visible caption. Exactly one of aria-label or aria-labelledby when interactive.

components.name: useChipField
components.description: Optional state helper. Field.ChipInput stays fully controlled without it.

props.name: initialChips
props.description: Starting chips.

props.name: initialInputValue
props.description: Starting input text.

props.name: dedupe
props.description: Skip commits that already exist.

props.name: transform
props.description: Normalize a commit. Null rejects. Default trims and rejects empty.

components.name: useChipList
components.description: Returns { listRef, measureRef, visible, hidden, measured }. visible is a prefix of chips. hidden is the +N count, capped at chips.length; 0 when maxRows is unset. measured is false on the server and before the first layout pass. Put listRef on the wrapping list (its width and gap drive the fold). The measure row on measureRef must be inert and aria-hidden and contain every chip, then a "…" probe chip, then Chip.Overflow with overflowCount={chips.length || 1}.

props.name: chips
props.description: Chip labels, in order. visible is always a prefix.

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Fold chips that do not fit into +N. Unset shows every chip.

props.name: reserveWidth
props.description: Element whose computed min-width stays free on the last line. A ref so density changes stay current.

components.name: useCombobox
components.description: Headless combobox state. Spread getters onto Field, Button, Popover, BottomSheet, and OptionList. No Combobox chrome.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Single uses TextInput. Multiple uses ChipInput.

props.name: options
props.description: Sync options. Ignored when loadOptions is set.

props.name: loadOptions
props.description: Async options. Stale responses are discarded. An inline function is fine; it is read at call time.

props.name: loadKey
props.description: Reloads options when it changes. Use it when loadOptions depends on state outside the query, such as a category.

props.name: presentation
props.description: auto uses useSheetPresentation.

props.name: allowCreate
props.description: Show a create row when the query has no case-insensitive label match.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value. Null for empty single. Array for multiple.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: Controlled filter text.

components.name: useField
components.description: Joins a custom control to the nearest Field.Root. Spread getControlProps on the control. Takes no options.

components.name: useHighlight
components.description: Returns { ref, matches }. Put ref on the element to search. matches holds a live Range per match of query, in document order, and is empty on the server. Ranges paint through CSS.highlights under name, so nothing is added to the DOM; style them with ::highlight(name). The hook searches again when text or elements under ref change.

props.name: name
props.description: Name to style with ::highlight(name). Give each hook its own name.

props.name: query
props.description: Text to find inside the element on ref. A list matches any of its terms; empty strings are skipped.

props.name: caseSensitive
props.description: Match letter case exactly.

props.name: ranges
props.description: More ranges to paint, such as the current match. They need no ref and are not added to matches.

props.name: priority
props.description: Which highlight paints on top where two overlap. Higher wins.

props.name: type
props.description: Highlight type, for spelling and grammar marks.

components.name: useModalLayer
components.description: useModalLayer(ref, open). Puts a modal <dialog> of your own in Todae's modal stack once open is true and it is shown with showModal(), until close(). Toast.Region moves its toasts into the modal in front. Dialog and BottomSheet join the stack by themselves.

props.name: ref
props.description: The <dialog>.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog may be shown. It joins once this is true and it is shown with showModal(), and stays until close().

components.name: usePopover
components.description: One open machine. Spread getTriggerProps onto the trigger and getPopoverProps onto Popover.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires on toggle or dismiss. Leaving open unchanged is a veto.

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: Sets CSS anchor-name on this element and excludes it from outside press.

props.name: initialFocusRef
props.description: Focus this element when the popover opens.

props.name: restoreFocusRef
props.description: Return focus here when the popover closes.

props.name: enabled
props.description: False skips toggle, dismiss, and focus moves.

props.name: haspopup
props.description: aria-haspopup on the trigger. Use "listbox" for an OptionList in a role-less popover.

props.name: id
props.description: Popover id. Default is a generated id.

components.name: useRovingFocus
components.description: One tab stop for a composite. Spread getContainerProps on the group and getItemProps(value) on each item.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which arrow keys move focus. Left and Right swap in a right-to-left container.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wrap from the last item to the first and back.

props.name: typeahead
props.description: Typing focuses the next item whose text starts with the typed characters.

props.name: tabStop
props.description: Keep one item tabbable. False when focus only enters from code, as in a menu: every item gets tabIndex -1.

props.name: activeValue
props.description: Controlled tab stop. Falls back to the first enabled item when null, disabled or missing.

props.name: defaultActiveValue
props.description: Initial tab stop when uncontrolled.

props.name: onActiveValueChange
props.description: Fires when an item other than activeValue takes focus, including a fallback tab stop, so a controlled owner can pin it.

components.name: useSheetPresentation
components.description: Coarse pointer or narrow width selects sheet. SSR and first paint are popover. isSheet mirrors presentation.

props.name: narrowWidth
props.description: Viewport width that starts the narrow media query. Media is max-width: n - 1.

props.name: coarseQuery
props.description: matchMedia query treated as coarse pointer.

props.name: forced
props.description: Skip media when popover or sheet. auto uses coarse OR narrow.

components.name: useTooltip
components.description: One open machine. Spread getTriggerProps onto the trigger and getTooltipProps onto Tooltip. Interactive is a non-modal tip dialog.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Use the non-modal tip dialog. Links only. Never role=tooltip.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires after a commit. Leaving open unchanged is a veto.

props.name: showDelay
props.description: Hover show delay in milliseconds. Focus shows at once.

props.name: hideDelay
props.description: Hide delay in milliseconds.

props.name: enabled
props.description: False resets intent and commits close.

props.name: id
props.description: Tooltip id. Default is a generated id.
